genre: 事故复盘 postmortem（与壳中客『LLM 工具自进化失败』体裁同构对照）
move_sequence: FRAME(范围+调查启动) → 澄清指控句(To state it plainly...) → 认错句(we didn't meet that bar) → 透明度元话语(We don't typically share...) → CONTEXT(架构背景) → ARGUE(时间线) → ARGUE×3(三 bug 定义+Resolution 固定字段) → CONTEXT(XLA 技术深潜) → COUNTER(Why detection was difficult——自我批评节) → APPLY(What we're changing 三条) → CLOSE(致谢+反馈渠道)

moves.evidence_excerpt: To state it plainly: We never reduce model quality
We don't typically share this level of technical detail
The first bug was introduced on August 5

moves.sub: 失败归因节（检测为何难）
moves.evidence_excerpt: we relied too heavily on noisy evaluations
More sensitive evaluations / Quality evaluations in more places / Faster debugging tooling

argument.evidence_types: 时间线（精确到日）+ 影响面百分比矩阵（0.8%/16%/0.18%/0.0004%）+ 根因技术链（bf16/fp32 精度失配→approximate top-k）
argument.qualifiers: approximately / a small subset / we believe this could have impacted
argument.rebuttals: 两层自我批评：①检测为何难（evals 太噪、隐私实践妨碍调试——诚实的两难承认）②'这些差距本应更早识别'
argument.conclusion_form: commitment+appeal（三条改进 + 请用户继续反馈 /bug 命令）

style_notes: Resolution: 固定字段（每个 bug 一个解决块——模板化复盘）；精确值癖与壳中客同族（0.0004% 级别的诚实披露）；透明度元话语显式声明分享尺度；'Model quality is non-negotiable' 价值句嵌入技术论证；致谢社区反馈收束（用户信号是检测链一环）
